name: Self test
description: A Lua test tool: on entering the world it calls every function the test mods give the client's Lua and checks each answer, sends chat and addon messages and changes a CVar, makes mods reload and break and repair a manifest, provokes casts, a cooldown, an item use and an equipment change, reloads the interface and logs out and back in, reads files the asset pipeline serves and converts, hangs a model on the player's head, checks the asset bricks; every result is a PASS, FAIL, SKIP or NOTE line in the log.
